name: agent-otel
description: Understand your AI agents from the OpenTelemetry data they emit — draw conclusions about failures, performance, tokens, and sessions, directly in VS Code.

languageModelTools.name: agent-insights_listTraces
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns recent trace rows — most recent first — with traceId, root span name, service name, timestamp, duration, span count, and error state. Agent-host wrapper traces are split into one logical trace per direct child subtree; their traceId is a stable composite accepted by getTrace. Standalone OTLP traces retain their original traceId. Supports filtering by serviceName, time window (since/until), errorsOnly flag, and span attribute values. To filter by a specific attribute, provide attributeKey (e.g. 'gen_ai.request.model') and attributeValue (e.g. 'gpt-4o'). To do a loose search across all attributes, provide only attributeValue. To find traces from a specific period (e.g. 'yesterday'), use both since and until together (e.g. since='2d' until='1d'). Follow up with getTrace to drill into any row's span tree.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Browse recent traces with optional service and time filters.

serviceName.description: Filter traces to a specific service name.

since.description: Only include traces after this point. Relative: '5m', '1h', '24h', '7d'. Absolute: ISO 8601 string.

until.description: Only include traces before this point. Relative: '1d' means 'more than 1 day ago'. Use with since to isolate a window, e.g. since='2d' until='1d' = yesterday only.

limit.description: Maximum number of traces to return. Defaults to 20.

errorsOnly.description: When true, only return traces that contain at least one errored span.

attributeKey.description: Attribute name to filter on (e.g. 'gen_ai.request.model', 'http.method'). Use with attributeValue for an exact match.

attributeValue.description: Attribute value to filter on. If attributeKey is also provided, matches exactly on that key. If used alone, does a substring search across all span attributes.

languageModelTools.name: agent-insights_getTrace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Given a traceId returned by listTraces, returns its complete span tree. The id may be an original OTLP trace id or a logical agent-host segment id. Each span shows its status (OK/ERROR), kind, duration, parent/root relationship, start time, and notable attributes (exception details, HTTP method/URL/status, DB statements, gen_ai model/tool attributes). When the trace belongs to an agent session, also returns the resolved sessionId and a deeplink that opens that specific session in the Sessions tab. Works for any trace — not just errors.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Inspect the full span tree for any trace.

traceId.description: The original or logical trace ID to inspect. Obtain from listTraces or findRecentErrors.

languageModelTools.name: agent-insights_getServiceSummary
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns a full performance profile for a single service or agent, filtered by its service_name. Includes: trace count, error rate, p50/p95 latency, slowest operations, LLM token usage, and tool call stats — all scoped to that service. Call without a serviceName first to list available services. Use this to compare two agents (e.g. Codex vs Copilot) by calling it once per service and comparing the results. ALWAYS use this when the user asks why one agent is faster, slower, or uses more tokens than another. Scoped to a service, never to a session: it aggregates across every session of that service, so when the comparison is between specific sessions, call getSessionSummary once per sessionId instead.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get a detailed telemetry breakdown for a specific service or agent.

serviceName.description: The service_name to filter by (e.g. 'codex', 'copilot'). Omit to list all available service names.

since.description: Only include telemetry after this point. Relative: '5m', '1h', '24h', '7d'. Absolute: ISO 8601 string e.g. '2024-01-15T10:00:00Z'.

until.description: Only include telemetry before this point. Use with since to isolate a time window, e.g. since='2d' until='1d' = yesterday only.

languageModelTools.name: agent-insights_getSessionSummary
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns a per-session summary for a single agent session (a conversation grouping multiple traces/turns from one agent — Copilot, Claude Code, or Codex). Includes a deeplink, outcome, key stats (turns, spans, LLM requests, tool calls, tokens, duration), a turn-by-turn timeline, per-tool usage, per-model token usage, and error details. Use this as the only tool needed to describe WHAT HAPPENED in a session, its OUTCOME, and its KEY STATS. If the user supplied a sessionId, call once with that id. Otherwise call without a sessionId to list recent sessions, then call once with the selected id. Do not call aggregate error, token/tool, performance, service, or trace tools to restate facts already in this result. Use another tool only when the user explicitly asks for transcript content or span-level details not included here.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Summarize a single agent session: what happened, outcome, and key stats.

sessionId.description: The session id to summarize. Omit to list recent sessions and their ids first.

limit.description: When listing sessions (no sessionId), the maximum number to return. Defaults to 20.

languageModelTools.name: agent-insights_getSessionMessages
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the CAPTURED CONVERSATION CONTENT an agent exported — user prompts, available model responses and reasoning, and tool calls and results, turn by turn — plus a deeplink that opens the session. Provider telemetry differs: missing assistant text means it was not captured or exported, not necessarily that the model produced no prose. Use this when the user asks WHY something happened or what was asked or answered. getSessionSummary returns session structure rather than turn-by-turn content; call it first to find the interesting turn, then call this tool for that narrow range. Output is paged and truncated: it returns turnCount turns starting at fromTurn (default 10 turns from turn 1). Never request a long transcript in one call. Call without a sessionId first to list recent sessions and their ids.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read the captured prompts, responses, and tool activity from an agent session.

sessionId.description: The session id whose transcript to read. Omit to list recent sessions and their ids first.

fromTurn.description: 1-based turn to start from. Defaults to 1. Use the value suggested in a previous result to page forward.

turnCount.description: How many turns to return, starting at fromTurn. Defaults to 10, maximum 25. Keep this small and page instead of requesting everything.

maxCharsPerTurn.description: Truncation cap for each turn's prompt and response text. Defaults to 1500, maximum 6000. Raise it only when a specific turn was truncated and you need its full text.

limit.description: When listing sessions (no sessionId), the maximum number to return. Defaults to 20.

languageModelTools.name: agent-insights_summarizeRecentActivity
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this as the primary tool when the user asks about their application's health, status, or telemetry in general without a more specific focus. Returns a high-level summary: trace/span/log counts, error rate, p95 latency, LLM token usage, and tool call totals. Do not add it to a request already handled by a more specific session, error, latency, token/tool, trace, log, or metric tool.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get a quick health overview of your application's telemetry.

since.description: Only include telemetry after this point. Relative: '5m', '1h', '24h', '7d'. Absolute: ISO 8601 string e.g. '2024-01-15T10:00:00Z'.

until.description: Only include telemetry before this point. Relative: '1d' means 'more than 1 day ago'. Use with since to isolate a window, e.g. since='2d' until='1d' = yesterday only.

languageModelTools.name: agent-insights_findRecentErrors
languageModelTools.modelDescription: ALWAYS call this tool when the user asks about errors, failures, exceptions, crashes, what broke, or recent problems. Returns the most recent error traces with errored span details including exception type and message.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find the most recent error traces in your application.

limit.description: Maximum number of error traces to return. Defaults to 5.

since.description: Only include errors after this point. Relative: '5m', '1h', '24h', '7d'. Absolute: ISO 8601 string e.g. '2024-01-15T10:00:00Z'.

until.description: Only include errors before this point. Use with since to isolate a time window.

languageModelTools.name: agent-insights_getSlowestSpans
languageModelTools.modelDescription: ALWAYS call this tool when the user asks anything related to slowness or performance — including: 'why did it take so long', 'why is it slow', 'what's taking so long', 'why was it slow', 'it's too slow', 'slow response', 'slow request', 'slow tool call', 'slow agent', 'high latency', 'latency spike', 'timeout', 'lag', 'delay', 'bottleneck', 'performance problem', 'performance regression', 'what is the slowest', 'optimize', 'speed up'. This applies to questions about ANY system emitting telemetry — the user's app, agent, LLM calls, tool calls, or any traced operation. Returns the slowest operations aggregated by span name, sorted by average duration descending, with avg/max duration and error counts. Takes only a time window — it cannot be filtered by sessionId or traceId, so it aggregates across unrelated sessions. When the user's scope is one or more specific sessions, their durations come from getSessionSummary's timeline and getTrace instead; do not call this tool merely because a session-scoped request mentions slowness.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find the slowest operations in your application.

limit.description: Maximum number of operations to return. Defaults to 10.

since.description: Only include spans after this point. Relative: '5m', '1h', '24h', '7d'. Absolute: ISO 8601 string e.g. '2024-01-15T10:00:00Z'.

until.description: Only include spans before this point. Use with since to isolate a time window.

languageModelTools.name: agent-insights_searchLogs
languageModelTools.modelDescription: ALWAYS call this tool when the user asks about logs, log messages, log output, or wants to search for a specific message, error string, or keyword in logs.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search your application logs for a keyword or phrase.

query.description: Text to search for in log body, service name, or severity.

minSeverity.description: Minimum OTLP severity number. 0=all, 9=INFO+, 13=WARN+, 17=ERROR+. Defaults to 0.

limit.description: Maximum number of log records to return. Defaults to 50.

since.description: Only include logs after this point. Relative: '5m', '1h', '24h', '7d'. Absolute: ISO 8601 string e.g. '2024-01-15T10:00:00Z'.

until.description: Only include logs before this point. Use with since to isolate a time window.

languageModelTools.name: agent-insights_listMetrics
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists OTLP metric instruments with name, service, metric type, unit, series count, point count, and last report time. Supports filtering by name, service, type, and time window. ALWAYS call this when the user asks which metrics are available, emitted, or being collected, or asks generally about OTLP counters, gauges, or histograms. Follow up with getMetric for values, trends, comparisons, and attribute dimensions. This tool covers the OpenTelemetry metrics signal, not token/tool usage reconstructed from spans.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Browse OpenTelemetry metric instruments and discover what is available.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against metric instrument names.

serviceName.description: Exact service name to include. Use the service name returned by listMetrics.

metricType.description: Only include instruments of this OTLP metric type.

since.description: Only include instruments with points after this time. Relative: '5m', '1h', '24h', '7d'. Absolute: ISO 8601 string.

until.description: Only include instruments with points before this time. Use with since to isolate a time window.

limit.description: Maximum number of instruments to return. Defaults to 30.

languageModelTools.name: agent-insights_getMetric
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Given an exact metric name and serviceName returned by listMetrics, returns temporality-aware OTLP metric details: the interpreted activity total, average, or value; histogram statistics; up to 20 recent chart buckets; previous-window comparison when a bounded window is supplied; token/model chart breakdowns where available; and top attribute dimensions. ALWAYS call this after listMetrics when the user asks for a metric's value, behavior over time, trend, change, spike, breakdown, or dimensions.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Inspect one OpenTelemetry metric's values, trend, comparison, and dimensions.

name.description: Exact metric instrument name returned by listMetrics.

serviceName.description: Exact service name returned by listMetrics. Use an empty string when the instrument has no service name.

since.description: Only include metric activity after this time. Relative: '5m', '1h', '24h', '7d'. Absolute: ISO 8601 string.

until.description: Only include metric activity before this time. Use with since for a bounded window and comparison against the preceding equal-duration window.

languageModelTools.name: agent-insights_getTokenAndToolUsage
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns LLM token usage and tool-call statistics derived from SPANS (not from OTLP metric instruments). Token usage is grouped by model and shows prompt/completion tokens, call count, and cache hit rate; tool-call stats show call count, error rate, and average duration per tool. ALWAYS call this when the user asks about token consumption, LLM cost, model usage, tool-call behavior, which tools are failing, or tool performance. This does NOT cover raw OTLP metric instruments (counters/gauges/histograms) — those are a separate signal.
languageModelTools.userDescription: See token usage per model and tool-call stats for your agent (computed from spans).

since.description: Only include spans after this point. Relative: '5m', '1h', '24h', '7d'. Absolute: ISO 8601 string e.g. '2024-01-15T10:00:00Z'.

until.description: Only include spans before this point. Use with since to isolate a time window, e.g. since='2d' until='1d' = yesterday only.

agentInsights.hideUtilityModels.description: Hide configured utility/free models from aggregate and model lists. Raw traces and spans remain available.

agentInsights.utilityModels.description: Case-insensitive model-name substrings treated as utility/free models when hiding utility models.
